label: m8d-2a-rank-consistent-critical-path

m8d2b_assessment.recommendation: Prioritize stress exchange while implementing symmetric start/finish infrastructure for both exchanges.

metric_definitions.component_wise_rank_maxima: For each phase independently, max_r(phase_r); sums can combine different ranks.
metric_definitions.speedup: combined early/late 1x1 critical-total median / layout critical-total median
metric_definitions.sum_of_component_maxima_fraction: (median(max_r velocity_exchange_r) + median(max_r stress_exchange_r)) / median(critical_total); legacy diagnostic only

performance_interpretation: The fixed global workload may exhibit superlinear single-node speedup, plausibly due to cache/working-set effects; hardware-counter confirmation was not performed.

provenance.revision_context: Uncommitted benchmark candidate based on base_sha; no candidate commit exists.

run_protocol.order_policy: deterministic interleave with early and late 1x1 references
run_protocol.speedup_reference: combined median of early and late 1x1 measured runs

scope: Single-node WSL decomposition scaling; these measurements do not establish distributed-cluster scaling.
timer: MPI_Wtime around four coarse phases; disabled unless DENISE_PSV_MPI_TIMING_FILE is set
timer_overhead: eight MPI_Wtime calls per timestep, one pre-loop barrier, no barriers inside the timestep loop; one small rank-record gather and JSON output occur after the loop

orientation_assessment.criterion: Meaningful only when the relative median difference exceeds the larger full run-to-run relative range.

reference_1x1.speedup_reference: median of all early and late measured 1x1 timestep-loop values
